notes.title: Difficulty explanation and update
notes.content: [h1][b]Normal Difficulty ( renamed to Very Challenging )[/b][/h1][h3]Is very challenging by design, game was created with this difficulty as default, hence it called "normal".[/h3][p] [/p][list][*][p]You will need to sprint around fast, often prioritizing survival over shooting[/p][/*][*][p]switch weapons more instead of reloading machine gun midfight[/p][/*][*][p]use Slam Away strategically (kills with Slam Away reload all guns)[/p][/*][*][p]use pickups strategically (when you have 100+ HP/Armor you get 30% from pickup)[/p][/*][/list][h3]But to make it not so frustrating there's plenty of checkpoints so you don't loose much time when dying.[/h3][p][/p][h1]Lower Difficulties[/h1][h3]You can scale it down all the way to 5% of incoming damage and enemies run speed to 50%[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Issues I know of[/h1][list][*][p]Slow loading time, especially on lower end CPUs - this will be improved [b]( UPD. - fixed )[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Crashes, especially on lower end CPUs - weaker CPUs often crash apparently, looking into that also [b]( UPD. - fixed one cause of crash, not sure is there any other causes)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Update notes[/h1][list][*][p]fixed that sometimes difficulty incoming damage multiplier didn't work[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted difficulty presets - all levels below normal now have much lesser values[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Slow loading time, especially on lower end CPUs - this will be improved ( UPD. - fixed )
- Crashes, especially on lower end CPUs - weaker CPUs often crash apparently, looking into that also ( UPD. - fixed one cause of crash, not sure is there any other causes)
- fixed that sometimes difficulty incoming damage multiplier didn't work

tags.balance_change: -adjusted difficulty presets - all levels below normal now have much lesser values
